protocol.split: 70% train / 30% held out, stratified independently per seed
protocol.sequence: digit cue once -> variable blank delay -> label-free query
protocol.feedback_order: predict query with theta_t, score, then optionally update readout
protocol.trainable_scope: readout only; temporal injection and transitions frozen
protocol.state_reset: reset at every independent digit sequence
protocol.evaluation: held-out digits with learning disabled and exact zero-drift audit
limitations: three seeds are a mechanism screen, not confirmatory evidence
the blank-delay task tests fading activation memory, not interference-rich recall
only readout weights learn; delayed credit assignment into injection is not tested
identity and unistochastic reservoirs are not compute-matched to all linear controls
this does not test an LM token head, Go strength, or animal-level learning
